1.

Mr. Sachin Mahato, learned counsel for the petitioner prays for withdrawal of the present writ petition with liberty to the petitioner to take other recourse(s) as available under law for redressal of his grievance.
2. Considering the aforesaid prayer, the present writ petition is disposed of as withdrawn with aforesaid liberty.

(Rajesh Shankar, J.) Rohit/
